---
title: "FSMI-RLE ROS 2"
---

## Overview

A next-best-view planner that integrates FSMI-RLE information-gain metrics into the ROS 2 navigation stack. Enables autonomous exploration by selecting viewpoints that maximize expected map information.

## Tech Stack

- **Languages:** C++, Python
- **Frameworks:** ROS 2
- **Libraries:** OctoMap, FSMI-RLE
- **Methods:** Next-best-view planning, information-driven exploration
